name: cookery
description: Hands-free cooking in Codex voice with a one-second camera folder and inline visual references.

interface.shortDescription: Cook by voice with a ceiling camera and visual guidance
interface.longDescription: A macOS cooking companion using your iPhone's QuickTime preview. A small shell script saves a fresh picture every second; Codex checks the latest picture when you ask and shows useful food references inline.
defaultPrompt: Set up my hands-free kitchen camera.
Let's cook. Check the latest camera picture when I ask and show me visual references when useful.
